artist.name: Dameer
artist.bio: Dameer (Dameer Khan) is a Bangladeshi singer, producer and DJ, born in Dhaka and now based in Montreal. He started as an indie singer-songwriter, signed to the German label Majestic Casual at 17, and now DJs house and techno sets that remix 70s to 90s Bengali classics and runs Bengali raves.

eras.sound: Synth-led indie pop singles in English and Bangla
